# Third-party code: swarm/bench-ws-adv (slot 132)

No new dependencies and no copied code. `crates/galion-wallstreet` still depends only on `serde`, `serde_json`
(MIT OR Apache-2.0) and the in-tree `zagreb-time`; `galion-bench` stays a dev-dependency. The homoglyph, leetspeak and
intent lexicons in `src/intent.rs` were written for this crate. Cargo.lock is unchanged by this branch.
